IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description:
Client-generated key for safely retrying a mutation. Reusing the same
key with the same authenticated principal, method, path, and payload
replays the original response before mutable resource lookup, including
after the resource has been deleted or changed. Bearer-token retries
are isolated by token credential, even when tokens belong to the same
agent actor. Location and ETag from the original response are replayed;
using the same key for another method, path, or payload under that
principal returns 409 Conflict; different principals may reuse the
visible key independently. Authentication
setup, login, and logout do not accept this header, and secret token
issuance rejects it so plaintext cannot be replay-cached.

RequiredIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
RequiredIdempotencyKey.description:
Required client-generated key for safely retrying this dependency
mutation. The value must contain at least one non-whitespace character
and be at most 255 characters. Reusing it with the same authenticated
principal, method, path, and payload replays the original response;
using it for a different method, path, or payload under that same
principal returns 409 with `idempotency_key_reused`. Different
principals (and bearer credentials) have isolated key namespaces.

ReleaseIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
ReleaseIdempotencyKey.description:
Required client-generated key for safely retrying this release
mutation. Reusing it with the same authenticated principal, method,
path, and payload replays the original response; using it for a
different method, path, or payload under that principal returns 409
with `idempotency_key_reused`. Different principals (and bearer
credentials) have isolated key namespaces.

BetaSwitchIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
BetaSwitchIdempotencyKey.description:
Required client-generated key for safely retrying this beta switch.
Reusing it with the same authenticated principal, method, path, and
payload replays the original `202` response; using it for a different
method, path, or payload under that principal returns `409` with
`idempotency_key_reused`. Different principals have isolated key
namespaces.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description:
Exact last observed task, audit-finding, or comment ETag. The value must
be quoted as "vN" with N a positive decimal version. Missing If-Match
returns 428, malformed values return 400, and a stale resource version
returns 409 (task conflicts include the current task in
error.details.current when the caller can read task details).

ProjectColumnIfMatch.name: If-Match
ProjectColumnIfMatch.description:
Optional last observed project or column ETag for an optimistic
administration edit. Values use the quoted "vN" format. Omit this
header only for legacy unguarded writes; stale guarded edits return
409 with the current resource version in error details.

ReleaseIfMatch.name: If-Match
ReleaseIfMatch.description:
Exact strong release ETag in the quoted `"vN"` form. Missing
If-Match returns 428, malformed values return 400, and a stale release
version returns 409. Release PATCH, DELETE, complete, and reopen all
require this guard.
